first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior onboarding and signup simplification results suggest one focused intervention could address both funnel problems without immediately discounting prices. A guarded test is preferable because improved completion may not translate into qualified long-term revenue, while enterprise sales-assisted flows remain a potentially stronger quality benchmark.

final.rationale: Run an enterprise-only sales-assisted CTA experiment. The verified record shows a 24% increase in qualified leads and an 18% increase in qualified revenue with no retention change, best matching the primary objective of sustainable qualified revenue. Shortening onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and retention, while SMB signup simplification improved activation but slightly reduced retention and produced only a 4% qualified-revenue lift. Measure qualified revenue and retention as primary guardrails, since this experiment will not directly resolve SMB pricing pressure or broad activation declines.
